start.title: From a Distance
start.text:
Torches lead Jesus away in chains.
Your heart pounds. Do you dare follow?

choices.text: Run home and hide your shame
choices.feedback: Love must follow, even trembling.
John 18:15 — Peter followed Jesus, as did another disciple.
This hour is not for swords.

hide_consequence.title: Do Not Abandon
hide_consequence.text:
He needs witness, not abandonment.
Return to His shadow.

choices.feedback: You turn back into the night.

charge_consequence.title: Not by Force
charge_consequence.text:
He told you to put the sword away.
Follow softly, not in fury.

choices.feedback: You slip into the shadows.

gate.title: The Outer Gate
gate.text:
John speaks to the gatekeeper for you.
The door creaks open into firelight.

choices.feedback: Pride goes before falling.

choices.text: Lie about your name at once
choices.feedback: Deception breeds deeper denial.
John 18:16 — The other disciple, who was known to the high priest, spoke to the doorkeeper and brought Peter in.

boast_consequence.title: Not Yet, Peter
boast_consequence.text:
Boasting once cost you everything.
Enter humbly tonight.

choices.feedback: You step softly past the gate.

lie_consequence.title: Silence Over Lies
lie_consequence.text:
One lie always asks for another.
Go in without a word.

choices.feedback: You hold your tongue.

courtyard_fire.title: Among the Guards
courtyard_fire.text:
Cold bites your hands. A fire crackles.
Guards and servants warm themselves.

choices.feedback: Your face still catches the glow.
Luke 22:55 — Peter sat among them in the middle of the courtyard as they kindled a fire and sat down together.
Hiding in laughter never works.

joke_consequence.title: Not Like This
joke_consequence.text:
Your loud voice will undo you.
Quiet your heart instead.

choices.feedback: You bow your head silently.

pray_path.title: A Whispered Prayer
pray_path.text:
You ask for strength you do not feel.
A servant girl steps closer.

choices.feedback: She studies your face.

first_recognized.title: You Were With Him
first_recognized.text:
A servant girl says, "You were with
the Galilean. I know your face."

choices.feedback: Your stomach turns at your words.
Matthew 26:70 — Peter denied it before them all, saying, "I do not know what you mean."

choices.text: Glare at her in furious silence
choices.feedback: Silence here is its own denial.

confess_consequence.title: If You Had Spoken
confess_consequence.text:
The harder road would have held you.
But fear pulls another way.

choices.feedback: The lie slips out before you stop it.

glare_consequence.title: Words Spill Out
glare_consequence.text:
Your silence draws more eyes than words.
Fear loosens your tongue.

choices.feedback: The first denial leaves your lips.

second_recognized.title: Another Voice
second_recognized.text:
Another servant points: "This one too
was with Jesus of Nazareth."

choices.feedback: Returning calls more attention.
Your voice trembles with the lie.
Mark 14:70 — Peter denied it again.

walk_back_consequence.title: More Eyes Turn
walk_back_consequence.text:
Returning only sharpens the questions.
The lie is already on your lips.

choices.feedback: The second denial escapes you.

admit_consequence.title: Fear Wins Again
admit_consequence.text:
Truth shines for a moment in your heart.
Then fear smothers it.

choices.feedback: The second denial bursts out.

third_accusation.title: Your Accent Betrays You
third_accusation.text:
A man insists: "Surely you are one.
Your Galilean speech gives you away."

choices.text: Curse and swear, "I never knew him!"
choices.feedback: Your own oath cuts the night.

choices.text: "I am His. Strike me if you must."
choices.feedback: Matthew 26:74 — Peter began to curse and swear, saying, "I do not know the man."

choices.text: Flee through the gate at once
choices.feedback: You cannot outrun this moment.

courage_consequence.title: Fear Speaks Louder
courage_consequence.text:
Courage flickers, then fades to ash.
The oath rises up instead.

choices.text: Curse and swear, "I never knew him!"
choices.feedback: The third denial tears free.

flee_consequence.title: The Door Is Closed
flee_consequence.text:
Guards block the gate behind you.
Only your tongue can buy escape now.

choices.text: Curse and swear, "I never knew him!"
choices.feedback: The third denial pours out.

rooster.title: A Rooster Crows
rooster.text:
Far off, a rooster splits the dark.
Across the court, His eyes find yours.

choices.text: Look away and pretend not to see
choices.feedback: His gaze has already pierced you.
Matthew 26:74 — Immediately a rooster crowed.

choices.text: Shout that it is not your fault
choices.feedback: Only honest grief can heal this.

lookaway_consequence.title: He Sees You Anyway
lookaway_consequence.text:
No shadow can hide you from love.
Let His look reach you.

choices.feedback: His eyes are sorrow, not scorn.

shout_consequence.title: Stop the Shouting
shout_consequence.text:
Excuses cannot hold the truth back.
Only tears can.

choices.feedback: Your shouting falls into silence.

weeping.title: Out Into the Night
weeping.text:
"Before the rooster crows, you will
deny me three times." You remember.

choices.text: Harden your heart and walk on
choices.feedback: A broken heart is the doorway.
Matthew 26:75 — Peter went out and wept bitterly, remembering Jesus' words.

choices.text: Blame the guards for the lie
choices.feedback: Only your own heart can answer.

harden_consequence.title: Let the Tears Come
harden_consequence.text:
A hardened heart cannot be forgiven.
A broken one already is.

choices.feedback: You stumble outside, weeping.

blame_consequence.title: Own the Failing
blame_consequence.text:
The fault is yours. Mercy waits for it.
Carry it honestly into the night.

choices.feedback: You step into the cold and weep.

ending.title: Bitter Tears
ending.text:
Beyond the gate you fall to your knees.
Mercy will find you here, even now.
